issues.issue: Whether the claimants were pursued by the PSB for house church activity
issues.applicant_position: Claimants say they attended house church, escaped a PSB raid in 2008 and were then sought at home.
issues.result_text: Claimants are not being pursued by PSB, based on negative inferences from inconsistent evidence.

issues.issue: Whether the claimants are genuine Christians
issues.applicant_position: Claimants say they attend church and Bible classes in Canada and have basic Christian knowledge.
issues.result_text: Claimants are not genuine practising Christians in China or Canada; pastor letter and baptism certificate carry little weight.

issues.issue: Whether the claimants face forced sterilization or imprisonment for a second child under Guangdong policy
issues.applicant_position: Claimants fear forced sterilization or imprisonment for their second child if returned to China.
issues.result_text: Fines are more likely than sterilization or imprisonment; no real chance of forced sterilization in Guangdong.
